question: The average age of 54 students of a class is 37 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 38 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age of Teacher = New Average + (Old number of members × Increase in Average)

New Average = 38 years

Old number of members = 54 students

Increase in Average = 38 − 37 = 1 year

Age of Teacher = 38 + (54 × 1) = 38 + 54 = 92

**∴ The correct answer is 92 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 54 students = 37 years

Average age of whole group (54 students + 1 teacher = 55 members) = 38 years

**Formula Used:**

Sum of Ages = Average × Total Members

 Average Age Distribution
 
 
 54 Students (Avg: 37)
 
 
 1 Teacher (Age: ?)
 
 
• 
 

 
 
 55 Members Combined (New Avg: 38)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 54 students = 54 × 37 = 1998 years

⇒ Total age of 55 members = 55 × 38 = 2090 years

⇒ Age of the teacher = Total age of 55 members − Total age of 54 students

⇒ Age of the teacher = 2090 − 1998 = 92 years

**∴ The correct answer is 92 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inclusion Principle

When a new entity is included in a group, its value can be directly found as: Value = New Average + (Old Count × Increase in Average).

Basic Average Formula

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations.

Weighted Average

Combined average of two groups with sizes n₁ and n₂ and averages A₁ and A₂ is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
